verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce ships developer-facing CLIs, an MCP server and SDKs, so whether a user can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control. Restricted API keys, OCA data-access agreements and permissioned financial data are adjacent access controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
